cards.example_en: You can borrow my bike provided you return it tonight.
cards.example_zh: 只要你今晚归还，就可以借我的自行车。
cards.explain_zh: 连词provided (that)表示条件；that可省略。

cards.example_en: Remote working can improve employee satisfaction, provided that organisations offer adequate technical support and clear communication channels.
cards.example_zh: 只要机构提供充分的技术支持和明确的沟通渠道，远程办公就能提高员工满意度。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our local wholesaler delivers fresh fruit to shops every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们当地的批发商每天早上给商店配送新鲜水果。
cards.explain_zh: wholesaler主要向商家批量供货，而非直接零售。

cards.example_en: During my homestay, I cooked dinner with the family.
cards.example_zh: 寄宿期间，我和寄宿家庭一起做晚饭。
cards.explain_zh: 强调住进当地家庭；接待家庭常称host family。

cards.example_en: Observing how birds flap their wings can help engineers develop more efficient designs for small flying robots.
cards.example_zh: 观察鸟类如何振翅能帮助工程师为小型飞行机器人开发更高效的设计。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式flapped，进行式flapping，均双写p。

cards.example_en: I found a nearby plumber in the local directory.
cards.example_zh: 我在本地名录里找到了一位附近的水管工。
cards.explain_zh: 名录通常含联系方式；计算机中指文件目录。

cards.example_en: An online directory of community services can help new residents locate essential support more easily.
cards.example_zh: 社区服务在线名录可以帮助新居民更轻松地找到必要的支持。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My foot slipped off the pedal in the rain.
cards.example_zh: 雨中，我的脚从脚蹬上滑了下来。
cards.explain_zh: 英式过去式常写pedalled，美式写pedaled。

cards.example_en: An old cannon stood beside the castle entrance.
cards.example_zh: 城堡入口旁摆放着一门旧大炮。
cards.explain_zh: 复数可用cannon或cannons；勿与canon混淆。

cards.example_en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
cards.explain_zh: scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。

cards.example_en: The scent of flowers can attract pollinators, helping many plant species reproduce and maintain healthy ecosystems.
cards.example_zh: 花香可以吸引传粉动物，帮助许多植物繁殖，并维持健康的生态系统。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The painting shows a knight riding towards a castle.
cards.example_zh: 画中一位骑士正骑马奔向城堡。
cards.explain_zh: k不发音，与night同音；爵士头衔常用Sir。

cards.example_en: Museum displays about the medieval knight can help students understand how warfare shaped European society.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆关于中世纪骑士的展览可以帮助学生理解战争如何塑造欧洲社会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our neighbour travelled around Oceania with a small backpack.
cards.example_zh: 我们的邻居背着一个小背包游历了大洋洲。
cards.explain_zh: 专有名词，首字母大写；前面通常不加the。

cards.example_en: This toy comes with far too much plastic packaging.
cards.example_zh: 这个玩具用了太多塑料包装。
cards.explain_zh: 表示包装材料时通常不可数；一件包裹用package。

cards.example_en: Sorry for the interruption, but your taxi is here.
cards.example_zh: 抱歉打断一下，不过你的出租车到了。
cards.explain_zh: 一次打断可数；without interruption表示不间断。

cards.example_en: The linguist recorded my grandmother telling an old story.
cards.example_zh: 那位语言学家录下了我奶奶讲述一个古老故事的声音。
cards.explain_zh: linguist 指人；linguistics 指语言学，作单数学科名。

cards.example_en: An arctic fox curled up beside a snowy rock.
cards.example_zh: 一只北极狐蜷缩在一块覆雪的岩石旁。
cards.explain_zh: 指北极地区时用the Arctic；南极是the Antarctic。

cards.example_en: An arctic fox curled up beside a snowy rock.
cards.example_zh: 一只北极狐蜷缩在一块覆雪的岩石旁。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: There is a marked difference between these two cakes.
cards.example_zh: 这两块蛋糕有明显的差别。
cards.explain_zh: 学术写作中常表示“显著的”；词尾读/t/。

cards.example_en: The introduction of dedicated cycle lanes led to a marked increase in bicycle use among urban commuters.
cards.example_zh: 专用自行车道的启用使城市通勤者骑车出行的数量显著增加。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Getting her first job was a milestone for Sara.
cards.example_zh: 找到第一份工作是萨拉人生中的一个里程碑。
cards.explain_zh: 常指发展中的重要节点，常搭配in。

cards.example_en: We stacked the hay inside the barn before sunset.
cards.example_zh: 我们在日落前把干草堆进了谷仓。
cards.explain_zh: 指农场里的大型建筑，可储存农作物或饲养牲畜。

cards.example_en: Water vapour condensed into droplets on the cold window.
cards.example_zh: 水蒸气在冰冷的窗户上凝结成了水滴。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写为vapour，美式为vapor。

cards.example_en: Water vapour condensed into droplets on the cold window.
cards.example_zh: 水蒸气在冰冷的窗户上凝结成了水滴。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: They gather for worship in a small village chapel.
cards.example_zh: 他们聚在村里的一座小教堂做礼拜。
cards.explain_zh: 英式过去式worshipped，美式通常worshiped。

cards.example_en: My uncle avoids walking under ladders because of superstition.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔因为迷信，不愿从梯子下面走过。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指迷信用不可数；某种迷信观念可数。

cards.example_en: Parking across this entrance is a clear violation.
cards.example_zh: 把车停在这个入口处显然是违规行为。
cards.explain_zh: 用a violation of表示违反或侵犯某事物。

cards.example_en: Collecting personal information without consent may constitute a violation of privacy, even when the data remains confidential.
cards.example_zh: 未经同意收集个人信息，即使数据仍被保密，也可能构成对隐私的侵犯。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The mechanic found a loose cable during the inspection.
cards.example_zh: 机械师在检查时发现了一根松动的电缆。
cards.explain_zh: inspection指检查过程；检查某物用of连接。

cards.example_en: He saved half his earnings to buy a bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 他存下一半收入，用来买自行车。
cards.explain_zh: 以-s结尾的复数名词，作主语时谓语用复数。

cards.example_en: We rested beneath the gently waving branches of a willow.
cards.example_zh: 我们在柳树轻轻摇摆的枝条下休息。
cards.explain_zh: 多为wave的现在分词；静态的“波浪状”通常用wavy。

cards.example_en: We rested beneath the gently waving branches of a willow.
cards.example_zh: 我们在柳树轻轻摇摆的枝条下休息。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My conscience told me to return the lost wallet.
cards.example_zh: 我的良心告诉我应该归还捡到的钱包。
cards.explain_zh: conscience是良心；conscious是有意识的。

cards.example_en: I noticed a suspicious charge on my bank statement.
cards.example_zh: 我发现银行账单上有一笔可疑的扣款。
cards.explain_zh: 事物可疑用suspicious；怀疑某事用suspicious of。

cards.example_en: Although calorie information can guide food choices, a balanced diet also depends on nutrient quality.
cards.example_zh: 虽然热量信息可以指导食物选择，但均衡饮食也取决于营养质量。
cards.explain_zh: 食品语境的calorie通常指千卡；物理学中指卡。

cards.example_en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
cards.example_zh: 我的小表弟问恐龙为什么灭绝了。
cards.explain_zh: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

cards.example_en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
cards.example_zh: 如果不加强栖息地保护，许多濒危物种可能在未来几十年内灭绝。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: It was raining, but we went swimming anyhow.
cards.example_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是去游泳了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“反正”较口语化；勿与somehow混淆。

cards.example_en: She cracked a walnut and shared the kernel with me.
cards.example_zh: 她敲开一个核桃，把核桃仁分给了我一些。
cards.explain_zh: 指核桃或树时可数，指核桃木材时不可数。

cards.example_en: The bedroom feels airy with both windows wide open.
cards.example_zh: 两扇窗都大开着，卧室显得通风又舒适。
cards.explain_zh: 形容房间时指通风宽敞，不是“空气制成的”。

cards.example_en: Our hotel room had a luxurious bath overlooking the sea.
cards.example_zh: 我们的酒店客房里有一个可欣赏海景的豪华浴缸。
cards.explain_zh: luxurious指豪华舒适；luxuriant多指植物繁茂。

cards.example_en: Keep your keys in the small compartment inside your bag.
cards.example_zh: 把钥匙放在包里的小隔层中。
cards.explain_zh: 指较大空间内分隔出的部分，如包内隔层。

cards.example_en: The villain hid the stolen jewels inside a boot.
cards.example_zh: 那个恶棍把偷来的珠宝藏进了一只靴子里。
cards.explain_zh: 常指故事中的反派；别与villa“别墅”混淆。

cards.example_en: His imitation of a sleepy cat made us laugh.
cards.example_zh: 他模仿困倦猫咪的样子逗得我们大笑。
cards.explain_zh: 模仿行为通常不可数；一件仿制品用an imitation。

cards.example_en: Regular handwashing is a simple method of infection prevention.
cards.example_zh: 经常洗手是一种简单的预防感染的方法。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；动词搭配为prevent sb from doing。

cards.example_en: Investment in disease prevention can reduce pressure on hospitals and improve public health over the long term.
cards.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资疾病预防能够减轻医院压力并改善公共健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The horse pulled a wagon loaded with fresh apples.
cards.example_zh: 马拉着一辆装满新鲜苹果的货车。
cards.explain_zh: 英国英语也写作waggon；铁路义主要用于英式英语。

cards.example_en: Schools should broaden access to arts education so that students from all backgrounds can develop their creative abilities.
cards.example_zh: 学校应扩大艺术教育的覆盖范围，让各种背景的学生都能培养创造力。
cards.explain_zh: 常用于抽象范围；broaden your horizons指开阔眼界。

cards.example_en: Schools should broaden access to arts education so that students from all backgrounds can develop their creative abilities.
cards.example_zh: 学校应扩大艺术教育的覆盖范围，让各种背景的学生都能培养创造力。
